description:
Search for companies by name or ticker symbol.

Returns matching entities with CIK, all known names, and ticker symbols, plus
the SEC's SIC industry code and name (sic, sic_description) for companies that have one.
Use this to find a company's CIK before using other tools.

A result with succession_filing filed an 8-K12B or 8-K12G3 in the last five years: it
became the successor to an earlier registrant (a new holding company, a change of
domicile, a merger), and the ticker usually moved with it. Its filings before that date,
such as past 10-Ks, are often under the predecessor's CIK. To get the predecessor's
name, search that filing (search_document) for "successor" or "12g-3" -- filers write
"successor issuer", "successor registrant" or "successor to" -- then search for it.

Args:
    query: Company name or ticker (e.g. "apple", "AAPL", "Tesla")
    limit: Max results (1-50, default 10)
name: search_companies
title: Search Companies
